units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 4:1">Targ. Gen. IV, 1</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 30:26">Ib. XXX, 26</cite>; a. fr:—Fut. <cite ref="J00107"><he>יִדַּע</he></cite>, <cite ref="N00236"><he>יִנְדַּע</he></cite> (fr. <cite ref="N00236"><he>נדע</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 39:5">Targ. Ps. XXXIX, 5</cite> <he>אִידַּע</he> Ms. (ed. <he>אֵידַע</he>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 8:6">Targ. Ex. VIII, 6</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 33b:19">Ber. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>אנא לא האי יְדַעְנָע</he> I learned nothing either about this &c.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 103a:8">Snh. 103ᵃ</cite> (prov.—of one who derives no lesson from adversity or success) <he>בכיי ליה למר ולא י׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דלא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) they lament to you and you understand it not, they laugh to you and you understand it not; <he>וי ליה למאן דלא י׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>למר</he>) woe to him who knows not the difference between good and evil; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 106:8">Targ. Ps. CVI, 8</cite> <he>לאוֹדָעָה</he> (Ms. <he>לאַנְדָּ׳</he>, v. supra); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 11b:3">Snh. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>מְהוֹדְעִין אנחנא וכ׳</he> we (the Sanhedrin) notify you &c.; Y. ib. I, 18ᵈ top <he>מוֹדַעְנָא</he>; Tosef. ib. II, 6 <he>מְהוֹדַעְנָא</he> (Var. <he>מְהוֹדְעֵי אנחנא</he>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 33b:6">Sabb. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>מאן לוֹדְעֵיה לבר וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>מוֹדְעֵיה</he>) Oh, that some one would inform the son of Yoḥai &c.
<cite ref="Nedarim 62a:10">Ned. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>לאוֹדוּעֵי נפשיה</he> to make one’s self known (as a scholar).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 11:5">Gen. R. s. 11</cite> <he>מנאן את מוֹדַע לי</he> (some ed. <he>מְיַדַּע</he>) how will you prove it to me?; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:3">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>לינא מְיַדַּע לדין וכ׳</he> shall I not let him know with whom he is dealing?.
Gen. R. s. 11, v. supra.—Part. pass. מְיַדַּע friend.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 88:9">Targ. Ps. LXXXVIII, 9</cite> <he>מְיַדְּעַי</he> Ms. (ed. <he>מיודעי</he>, hebraism).

senses.gloss: to be made known, to make one’s self known.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 41:21">Ib. XLI, 21</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 21:11">Targ. Y. Deut. XXI, 11</cite> <he>תתידעון</he>, read: <he>תיתרעון</he>, as in v. 14.]—
<cite ref="Horayot 2a:18">Hor. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>כי מִתְיַדַּע להו לבי דינא</he> if the court were made aware of it.
<cite ref="Shabbat 71b:4">Sabb. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ ליה קודם וכ׳</he> he became aware of it before setting the sacrifice aside; a. e.
